translations.en: What?
Seems the town watch doesn't get along with them.
Town watch?
Yes, the lord hired mercenaries when Levia came,
They're the ones hired for emergencies.
In case of emergency... Levia occupies this town
Is that what you mean?
Yes, I keep telling them Levia wouldn't do that.
But the ones hired under those circumstances
The vigilantes are hostile toward Levia's group.
I see...
After the meal, I ate the last parsley garnish
I popped it into my mouth and stood up.
I'll work enough not to get Levia angry.
Seeing me stand, Shuri, who had already eaten,
also rose and looked at me.
Master
I'll be back by evening. Feel free until then.
Yes, understood.
Following Shuri's prompt reply, Rinsha also stood.
Well, I guess I'll get back to work too.
Saying that, she began clearing the dishes.
Please take care.
I passed through the door past Shuri bowing,
I stepped into the central plaza facing the inn,
From inside, I could hear Shuri's voice.
Miss Rinsha, please let me help...
(Oh dear, such a diligent girl...)
